mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output pressure corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS is rising, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, persistent inflationary pressures prompt Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1600), declining residential construction weakens the broader economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC for HOUST < 1600 is below 0.03.
